purpose: SMP boot, CPU-owned kernel gate and validated firmware topology tutorial illustrations
output_policy: Selected generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte into the repository; original generated images remain in place.
qa_method: Visual inspection of each generatedImage return against audited source and figure specifications; SHA256 source-copy equality and dimensions checked.

figures.name: smp-boot
qa_checks: Three-column, two-row layout and readable Chinese text
AP mailbox at 0x7e00 and startup code at 0x7000 distinct
Sequential AP startup and mailbox reuse only after online
16-to-32-to-64-bit startup bridge
Each CPU owns GDT/TSS/RSP0/IST1; one shared IDT
Clean 512B x87/SSE template, no AVX/XSAVE claim
online_count + 1 precedes release online = 1, which precedes waiting for BSP-owned kernel gate

figures.name: kernel-gate
qa_checks: Concurrent user computation and one shared serial kernel service
CPU owner and no recursive lock count
Save IF, CLI, acquire/CAS, conditional restoration of IF
User/idle exits release only with IF = 0; kernel return retains gate
Only BSP PIT advances global time; AP timer records local statistics
user_ticks includes kernel service time attributed to that user thread
Reschedule IPI 0xF1; EOI before possible stack switch; spurious 0xFF has no EOI

figures.name: topology
figures.discarded_first_generation_reason: The first generation invented incorrect EBDA absolute-address annotations. It was not copied into the repository; only built-in imagegen edited the text in panel (a).
qa_checks: EBDA base comes from BIOS 0x40e and code accepts 0x80000 <= base < 0xa0000
Conventional-memory size comes from BIOS 0x413; last 1KiB scan is MP-only
ACPI first then MP fallback; 16-byte candidate stride
RSDP-to-RSDT/XSDT-to-MADT chain with 32/64-bit pointer width
Type 0 enabled LAPIC enumeration and Type 5 LAPIC address override
BSP internal index 0 distinguished from hardware APIC ID
Four-CPU cap still checks later duplicate IDs
Little-endian 34 12 maps to 0x1234; APIC ASCII hex bytes correct
ID 255 broadcast rejected for unicast; x2APIC unsupported; complete MSR address match
Nonzero aligned LAPIC address below 4GiB; publish topology only after validation
